The moments before hello

You were still a dream.

I imagined your face, your little hands, and the world we would discover together.

Already part of my world

I hadn’t met you.
Yet you were everywhere.

In the little things I saved, the names I imagined, and the dreams I carried into every tomorrow.

The first hello

And then, there you were.

Every dream became a little person I could finally hold.
